# Pet Name Generator

> Free browser-based pet name ideas and practical naming guides.

## Core pages
- Home and generator: https://mirzacreative.github.io/petnamegenerator/
- Naming guides: https://mirzacreative.github.io/petnamegenerator/blog-index.html
- About and editorial policy: https://mirzacreative.github.io/petnamegenerator/about.html

## Animal generators
- Dog: https://mirzacreative.github.io/petnamegenerator/dog-name-generator.html
- Cat: https://mirzacreative.github.io/petnamegenerator/cat-name-generator.html
- Parrot: https://mirzacreative.github.io/petnamegenerator/parrot-name-generator.html
- Bird: https://mirzacreative.github.io/petnamegenerator/bird-name-generator.html
- Horse: https://mirzacreative.github.io/petnamegenerator/horse-name-generator.html
- Rabbit: https://mirzacreative.github.io/petnamegenerator/rabbit-name-generator.html

- Turtle: https://mirzacreative.github.io/petnamegenerator/turtle-name-generator.html

## Content notes
- Generated names are suggestions and are not guaranteed to be unique.
- Articles provide practical naming guidance, not veterinary or legal advice.
- Pages use visible headings, crawlable links, canonical URLs and JSON-LD.
